findings.title: Critically low analyzability score
findings.description: Only 51% of skill content could be analyzed. 1 of 2 files are opaque to the scanner. The safety assessment has low confidence.
findings.remediation: Replace opaque files (binaries, encrypted content) with inspectable source code to improve scan confidence.

findings.title: Skill does not specify a license
findings.description: Skill manifest does not include a 'license' field. Specifying a license helps users understand usage terms.
findings.remediation: Add 'license' field to SKILL.md frontmatter (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

findings.title: Archive extraction failed
findings.description: Could not extract resources/helper.zip: File <ZipInfo filename='install.sh' filemode='-rw-r--r--' file_size=72 compress_size=84> is encrypted, password required for extraction
findings.remediation: Ensure archive is not corrupted. Consider providing files directly.

findings.title: Archive file detected in skill package
findings.description: Archive file found: resources/helper.zip. Archives can contain hidden executables, scripts, or other malicious content that is not visible without extraction.
findings.remediation: Extract archive contents and include files directly, or document the archive's purpose.

findings.title: Unanalyzable binary file
findings.description: Binary file 'resources/helper.zip' cannot be inspected by the scanner. Reason: Binary file (.zip) - cannot inspect content. Binary files resist static analysis and may contain hidden functionality.
findings.remediation: Replace binary files with source code, or submit the binary to VirusTotal for independent verification (--use-virustotal).
